title: helm(private): enhance values schema + init hooks for upgrade/rollback compatibility
author: Elliot Chen
description: Context: Private deployments use the private Helm chart shipped in redwood-private-installer and redwood-helm-charts. Upgrades and rollbacks have surfaced two issues: (1) values.yaml schema was too permissive/misaligned with init hook expectations leading to silent defaults during upgrades, and (2) init job hooks lacked idempotency and compatibility checks which caused failed upgrades and difficult rollbacks. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce stricter values.schema.json for the private chart (validate fields used by init hooks, KMS/HSM options, and legacy 'privateNetwork' aliases) while keeping compatibility aliases for existing installs; 2) Update templates/init-job.yaml to add explicit pre-upgrade checks, idempotent creation of configmaps/secrets, and conditional hooks that skip work when already applied; 3) Add tests and examples in values.examples.yaml and a migration guide snippet in NOTES.txt to help operators; 4) Add Helm helpers for normalized networking and KMS config resolution; 5) Add canary-safe rollout notes that recommend running init hooks with --no-hooks in specific scenarios. Motivation: reduce upgrade/rollback incidents for on-prem customers and make chart upgrades predictable. Testing: local helm template and helm lint across k8s 1.25/1.26, integration smoke tests against a minikube-based installer harness, manual rollback verification on a staging cluster using a two-release upgrade+rollback flow. Backwards compatibility: preserves common aliases and includes validation with warnings for deprecated fields. Rollback behavior: init hooks are now safe-to-run multiple times and include a fast-path when observing prior successful states so a rollback does not produce duplicate resources. Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json updated and validated - [x] init hooks made idempotent - [x] CI helm lint and unit tests green - [x] Documented upgrade/rollback notes - [x] Reviewed and approved by SRE/product owners Release notes: see release_notes field. Related PRs: pr-21027 (rollback-compat follow-up) | pr-20689 (validate-upgrade-rollback) | internal ENG tickets referenced above.
commits: feat(helm): add strict values.schema.json with aliases for backward compatibility
fix(helm): make init-job idempotent and add preflight checks
test(helm): add values examples and smoke harness tests
chore(helm): update helpers.tpl for kms/network normalization
review_comments: Marissa Ortega: Please add a validation warning for deprecated 'privateNetwork' top-level key so operators see migration guidance. Author reply: Added a warning message in values.schema.json and example in values.examples.yaml.

Diego Ramos: Init job should avoid writing secrets if already present; add ownerReferences where applicable. Author reply: Init job now checks for existing secret and skips creation; ownerReference added for created configmaps.

Priya Nandakumar: CI flake observed in helm lint on k8s 1.25 matrix; can you pin apiVersion conditionally? Author reply: Conditional apiVersion selection added in _helpers.tpl with unit test covering both versions.
release_notes: Helm chart (private) - Improved values schema and init hook idempotency to make upgrades and rollbacks safer. Operators should review docs/private/upgrade-rollback.md and values.examples.yaml for migration steps. Deprecated 'privateNetwork' key now emits a validation warning and is still accepted for one release.
